units.name: prepare
units.summary: Install rules and the project note; see if setup is due

units.name: setup
units.summary: Write the overview spec and one spec per component

sizing.why: It reads a whole repository once and writes the specs every later task trusts

judge_sizing.why: It compares each written spec with the code it describes, one file at a time

units.name: triage
units.summary: Read the task, find the gaps, pick the route

sizing.why: It reads one task and the spec index to sort gaps and pick a route; the check verifies the note's shape

judge_sizing.why: It reads one note against the task; the route it confirms is cheap to correct later

units.name: discovery
units.summary: Close each gap with a spec, record or research note

sizing.why: It closes gaps by research and design, the deepest thinking in the workflow, and nothing downstream rechecks its facts

judge_sizing.why: It decides whether each gap is really closed across specs, records and research notes

units.name: plan
units.summary: Design requirements and phases; state complexity

sizing.why: It designs across specs and code, and a weak plan costs a whole code session

judge_sizing.why: It judges that the design covers every criterion and contradicts no spec it references

units.name: expand
units.summary: Write task rows and verification for a complex plan

sizing.why: It turns an approved plan into task rows and decides little

judge_sizing.why: It compares the task rows with the plan they expand

units.name: code
units.summary: Build the plan test first in one session

sizing.why: It is a long session that builds test first; the tests and the code check catch slips that more effort would not

judge_sizing.why: It reads the diff, the report and the proof of every criterion, and a miss ships a defect
